title: AI Agent Bridge
summary: Ask your running game a question in chat and get the answer in-game from an AI agent. The agent pulls only what each question needs over RCON, works for every force on a multiplayer server, and other mods can add tools to it. Needs the AI Agent Bridge service running beside the server (see source).
tags_intentionally_empty: No tag in the live portal vocabulary is honestly true of an AI question bridge; it is a gameplay-domain vocabulary. Discovery rests on title and summary.
